title: Bring back an old file

story.speaker: Sam
story.text: I definitely deleted the poster file, but now we need it back.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Instead of travelling back, you can grab a single file from the past.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Use `git restore --source=<commit-ID> <file>` to put an old file straight into your working folder.

hints: You need to know the commit ID where the poster was drafted.
Run `git log --oneline` to find the ID, then use `git restore`.
recap: `git restore --source=<commit-ID> <file>` takes a file from a past commit and puts it in your working folder.

cheatSheet.summary: Bring a specific file from the past into your working folder
